sections.shortTitle: Sindh Regularization of Contract Employees of Khairpur Medical College Khairpur Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XLIV OF 2018
ACT XLIV OF 2018
SINDH (REGULARIZATION OF CONTRACT EMPLOYEES OF
KHAIRPUR MEDICAL COLLEGE, KHAIRPUR) ACT, 2018
An Act to provide for regularization of the services of employees
appointed on contract basis in the Khairpur Medical College, Khairpur
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 7th June, 2018]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-B-21/2018,
dated 7.6.2018.---The Sindh
(Regularization of Contract Employees of Khairpur Medical College, Khairpur)
Bill, 2018 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 24th May,
2018 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 05th June, 2018 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to provide for
regularization of the services of employees appointed on contract basis in the
Khairpur Medical College, Khairpur, and to provide for matters connected
therewith or ancillary thereto;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh (Regularization of Contract Employees of Khairpur
Medical College, Khairpur) Act, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

2. Definitions.---(1) In this Act, unless context otherwise
requires'-
(a) "Act"
means the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973;
(b) "appointment"
means the appointment of a duly qualified employee made on contract basis;
(c) "civil
servant" shall have the same meaning as assigned to it in the Act;
(d) "employee"
means a person appointed on contract basis in the Khairpur Medical College,
Khairpur;
(e) "Government"
means the Government of Sindh;
(f) "post"
means a post held by an employee and sanctioned by Government connected with
the affairs of the Province.

Regularization of services of contract employees

ACT XLIV OF 2018
ACT XLIV OF 2018
SINDH (REGULARIZATION OF CONTRACT EMPLOYEES OF
KHAIRPUR MEDICAL COLLEGE, KHAIRPUR) ACT, 2018
An Act to provide for regularization of the services of employees
appointed on contract basis in the Khairpur Medical College, Khairpur
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 7th June, 2018]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-B-21/2018,
dated 7.6.2018.---The Sindh
(Regularization of Contract Employees of Khairpur Medical College, Khairpur)
Bill, 2018 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 24th May,
2018 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 05th June, 2018 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to provide for
regularization of the services of employees appointed on contract basis in the
Khairpur Medical College, Khairpur, and to provide for matters connected
therewith or ancillary thereto;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
3. Regularization
of services of contract employees.---(1)
Notwithstanding anything contained in the Act or rules made thereunder or any
decree, order or judgment of a court, but subject to other provisions of this
Act, an employee appointed on contract basis and is holding such appointment,
immediately before the commencement of this Act, shall be deemed to have been
validly appointed to that post as a civil servant on regular basis including
Principal of the College, with effect from the date of appointment.
(2) The
orders of regularization under subsection (1) shall not be made unless
antecedents of such employee with regard to his academic qualifications,
experience, age and place of domicile are scrutinized and cleared by the
Special Committee.
(3) The
Special Committee under subsection (2) shall be headed by the Secretary of the
Health Department and three other members, one from the Health Department to be
nominated by the Secretary Health Department and three from the Services Wing
of the Services and General Administration Department within six weeks.
